plugins.name: ytstack
plugins.description: BUNDLE: Yesterday Technologies Stack -- opinionated software-development OS for AI agents. Curated superpowers + gstack skills plus Project-OS artifact discipline (PROJECT.md, DECISIONS.md, KNOWLEDGE.md, milestone/slice/task hierarchy), orchestrated via SessionStart hooks.

plugins.name: office
plugins.description: BUNDLE: Daily-work core tier. Generic productivity, creative, and knowledge skills for daily work; nothing requires external SaaS keys at install time. Optional SaaS integrations (Figma, Miro, Voxtral TTS, VRR transit) live in office-extras.

plugins.name: office-extras
plugins.description: BUNDLE: Daily-work extras tier. Optional integrations needing external SaaS accounts/keys (Figma, Miro, Voxtral TTS, VRR transit). Install alongside office when you actually use these services.

plugins.name: personal-agent
plugins.description: BUNDLE: Yesterday Agent Stack -- generic skills for AI agents in human-AI collaboration and AI-as-expert workflows (Levels of AGI 3-4). Stateful patrols, agent-to-agent orchestration, self-improvement, durable infra ops. No Yesterday-infra dependencies; works for any team running long-running Claude Code agents.

plugins.name: systems-operations
plugins.description: BUNDLE: SysOps -- generic infrastructure-provisioning, deployment, and observability skills for agents. opentofu + railway-deploy + butler-deploy + land-and-deploy + canary + setup-deploy.

plugins.name: webflow
plugins.description: Ships the Webflow MCP server (remote HTTP, OAuth at mcp.webflow.com) plus the `webflow` skill, so any project or bundle can declare a single dependency to read and edit Webflow sites -- pages, CMS, assets, components, styles, variables, custom code, comments, localization, and publishing.

plugins.name: y-context7
plugins.description: Single-source MCP plugin that adds the Context7 server (npx @upstash/context7-mcp) for live, version-accurate library documentation lookups. Lets any bundle depend on one shared definition instead of redeclaring the server (avoids the Claude Code MCP-name dedupe warning). No API key required.

plugins.name: y-exa
plugins.description: Single-source MCP plugin that adds the Exa semantic-web-search server (npx exa-mcp-server), giving agents full-text web search and content retrieval. Lets any bundle depend on one shared definition instead of redeclaring the server (avoids the Claude Code MCP-name dedupe warning). Prompts for an Exa API key on enable via userConfig; get one at https://exa.ai/.

plugins.name: create-shareable-skill
plugins.description: Turn an existing skill or a fresh idea into a catalog-ready shareable skill -- run the quality gate, decide catalog and standalone-vs-bundle placement, pick the category, scaffold SKILL.md (+ optional .plugin.json), update the catalog docs, and open a PR. Use when adding a new skill to the catalog or promoting a personal skill into a shareable one.

plugins.name: creative-productivity
plugins.description: Generate professional consulting deliverables: Excalidraw diagrams, Mermaid visualizations, Reveal.js/Marp presentations, draw.io architecture diagrams, one-pagers, proposal documents. Orchestrator with enriched assets over the underlying tool plugins.

plugins.name: eigenbeleg
plugins.description: Create German Eigenbelege (substitute receipts) as signature-ready PDFs from payment-notification emails or bank records — verified payee data, embedded payment proof, correct German tax treatment. For expenses without an invoice: parking machines, vending machines, tips, lost receipts.

plugins.name: excalidraw-diagram
plugins.description: Generate Excalidraw diagrams. Create various types of diagrams, such as flowcharts, wireframes, infographics, and mind maps, to help visualize ideas and concepts.

plugins.name: figma-console-mcp
plugins.description: Connect AI agents to Figma via the Figma Console MCP server. Design system extraction, UI component creation, variable/token management, visual debugging, FigJam boards, Slides presentations.

plugins.name: miro-board
plugins.description: Create and read Miro board content via MCP tools. Diagrams (flowcharts, mindmaps, UML, ER), documents (markdown), tables, and context extraction.

plugins.name: paperclip-api
plugins.description: Manage Paperclip AI companies, agents, issues, projects, goals, routines, costs, and secrets via REST API. Use when creating companies, hiring agents, assigning tasks, managing budgets, or checking dashboards on a Paperclip instance.

plugins.name: para-memory-files
plugins.description: File-based memory system using Tiago Forte's PARA method. Agent-side persistence across sessions: knowledge graph in PARA folders, working memory, journal entries.

plugins.name: voxtral-tts-api
plugins.description: Mistral Voxtral TTS API client. Natural, emotionally expressive speech in 9 languages. Voice cloning from 3s samples, preset voices, streaming, cross-lingual synthesis.

plugins.name: vrr-efa-api
plugins.description: VRR (Verkehrsverbund Rhein-Ruhr) live transit API client. Departures, connections, stops via EFA API -- real-time, free, no API key. Niche regional vertical (German public transit).

plugins.name: web-design
plugins.description: Build distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use when building websites, landing pages, dashboards, web apps, or any UI that should look polished and modern.

plugins.name: wrapup
plugins.description: Wrapup of the conversation -- memorize features and requirements, extend roadmap / changelog / planning / agent context / decisions / specs, distill learnings, and prepare a resume prompt for after /compact. Lightweight, project-agnostic counterpart to ytstack:summarize-task / ytstack:handoff-session.
